notes.title: December Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Troublemakers!

We’re back again with another developer update!

Since class was last in session, we have completed all chapters of the story! We’re really excited for you all to experience it and we can’t wait for you to see it and tell us what you think!

We’ve also added difficulty settings that can changed at anytime in the gameplay settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/d06185a11488ddff33a258ed57c7b06bf16b5392.png[/img]

We’ve also added more advanced graphic settings (and there’s no need to restart the game every time you change them 😉)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/85bd944994ca3026a97ca2b25b9447c78e137641.png[/img]

Post-game scenes and end-credit content have also been completed. We can’t wait for you to see them!

In other news, we were also nominated in The Lazy Game Awards, an annual award ceremony for the Indonesian gaming community. The three categories we were nominated for were:

Indonesian Most Ancitipated Games 2022
Best Indonesian Game Developer
Indonesian Most Influential Person in Gaming

We won the Indonesian Most Anticipated Games 2022, and we could not be more excited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/7ff2900c5a8fa03ec64637482ac6c4c59e4c2789.png[/img]

We promise to work hard to live up to your expectations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/796ed27752a89c5e33d59f5f66e89a0dea0fea0f.png[/img]

We’re super duper excited for you all to see what we’ve been up to and working on, so don’t forget to check out our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/gxWfzgn3fE]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://twitter.com/GamecomTeam]Twitter[/url] for more sneak peeks 😉 We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay tuned, Stay UwU

notes.title: November Dev Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Troublemakers!

We’re back again with another developer update!

Since class was last in session, we have completed some super duper cool card minigames.

Here’s a sneak peek at one of them:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/89be32668fb1ecc98098aea2fd59b2d5550a434b.gif[/img]



A little about the game:

Each player is given 8 random cards.
Cards have 2 types. Attack cards are red and Defend cards are blue.
Attack cards will reduce enemy points at that location based on the card’s points.
Defensive cards will add player points at that location based on the card’s points.
The game ends when all the cards on both sides have been used.
The winner is whoever has the highest points in 2 or 3 sections out of the 3 sections!

We’ve also added a new super secret sick move and we can’t wait for you to see it. It’s so super secret that we shouldn’t give you a sneak peek…buuut… 👀

(Here’s a screenshot anyway! 🥳 )
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/c77432c6a837a5c3f86779eecd30244149403bed.png[/img]

You can buy all of these in the shop. Don’t spend all of your money at once, hehe!

We have some surprises coming up so we don’t want to spoil it all - but we’ve completed the last chapter of the game! We can’t wait for you to see it and tell us what you think!

We’re super duper excited for you all to see what we’ve been up to and working on, so don’t forget to check out our Discord and follow us on our socials for more sneak peeks 😉 We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay tuned, Stay UwU

notes.title: Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Troublemakers! 
You loved our last demo so much, that we're excited to announce that we've brought an updated version back for you all to try out for Dreamhack Beyond! The event runs from October 14th - October 23rd. Our demo will be up for the duration of the event and come down the afternoon of the 24th. 

We’ll see you all at school, troublemakers! Stay tuned, Stay UwU
Now onto the changes!
[list]
[*] Free Roam Demo
[*] Redefining the combat system and camera focus
[*] No more manual targeting, attack the enemy according to the direction of your attack
[*] 9 minigames in free roam demo
[*] 2 New Sick Moves
[*] Added some world Interaction (working on translation)
[*] Balancing difficulty
[*] Bug fix and minor improvements
[/list]

notes.title: NEW SPESIFICATION FOR RELEASE VERSION
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39369668/ac4f1354f94bb554e81bb266ac1d34b67cb12b8a.png[/img]

English:
So, guys, Ms.Vivi, our homeroom teacher, has an important announcement for you!
It's about Parakacuk game specifications, the final version specifications will be much lighter than the version we released previously,
Well, but for now, with a heavy heart, we won't be releasing the latest version, which has changed a lot of gameplay, graphics and control as you can see in our social media update UwU,
And with a heavy heart, we will remove the demo download button on Steam for the previous version, because we are afraid that there will be a miss when we do an update.
We want to know that this game will live up to all of your expectations in the final version!
Anyway, for those who haven't joined Team Gamecom's Discord server, Just join it please UwU

Jadi spesifikasi game Parakacuk di versi final nanti akan jauh lebih ringan dari versi yang kemarin kita rilis nih gaes,

Dan dengan berat hati kami akan menghilangkan tombol download demo di Steam untuk versi sebelumnya, karena ditakutkan akan ada miss ketika kami melakukan update.
Kami ingin pastikan bahwa game ini akan sesuai ekspetasi kalian semua di versi final nanti!
